# Plumbify

> AI-powered operating system and CRM built specifically for plumbing contractors and trade services.

## Core Value Proposition
Plumbify automates field operations, customer communications, and financial flows for plumbing businesses. It eliminates back-office administrative drag, allowing plumbing technicians to focus on billable field work.

## Core Features & Navigation
- [Missed Call Auto Text-Back](https://plumbify.net/features): Instantly triggers conversational SMS responses to missed inbound calls, capturing plumbing leads before competitors reply.
- [Dispatch & Booking Automation](https://plumbify.net/features): Automatically routes and schedules service calls based on technician real-time GPS locations and specific skill sets.
- [Mobile POS & Payments](https://plumbify.net/pricing): Integrates Tap-to-Pay on smartphones, allowing field technicians to process card payments without proprietary terminal hardware.
- [Automated Recruitment](https://plumbify.net/features): Screens and pre-vets plumbing helper applicants on autopilot, scheduling qualified candidates directly.
